## 3. DESCRIPTION (Final Public Copy — Plain Text)
Rain streaks down the window while neon light bleeds softly into the room.
A CRT monitor sits at the center of the desk, terminal text scrolling steadily as distant city glow reflects across glass and metal. The lamp is warm, the outside world is cold, and the rhythm of rain creates a sealed space for uninterrupted concentration.
This 3-hour LoFi + Synthwave mix is designed for night coding, deep study, writing, and long focus sessions after dark. Calm momentum, subtle motion, and a consistent atmosphere built for staying locked in.
All music is royalty-free and safe for content creators.
